doc.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Moving to New York after the Joe Bushkin job
summary: Referred by Jake Hanna, he played with Bushkin and then moved to New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: at that point, to New York. And about a year and a half later, I got a call from Joe Bushkin, a piano player, I was referred by my friend Jake Hanna that I’d gotten to know, and so at that point I made the trip back to play a couple of weeks with Joe Bushkin, and he had a return engagement coming a few months later for two months. So at that point I decided just to pack up and move to New York, because I figured with two months work I’d get started pretty well. And like that.
There you go. And you’ve been in New York since then?
